source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check LED Blinking behavior

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify by direct observation that the identified CRPS LED produces exactly the approved N flashes and then transitions to the required steady illuminated color/state, rather than an unrelated standby, identify, warning or fault indication.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the PSU and initial state, captures the full physical sequence, counts completed flashes, measures color/timing and confirms the specified steady-on dwell. The agent may analyze operator-provided media and collect read-only context but cannot originate the visual evidence.
manual_activity: The operator observes the correct bezel from before the first flash, counts N cycles, records color/cadence and confirms the final continuously illuminated state for the defined dwell without touching the PSU.
required_inputs: Numeric N and completed-flash counting rule
Initial state and approved sequence trigger or natural condition
Blink color/cadence/tolerance and final steady-ON color/dwell
PSU/BMC state distinguishing intended ON from warning, fault or identify
Qualified observer, time-linked recording and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not manipulate, reseat, unlatch, remove or power-cycle the PSU to trigger the sequence without a separately approved stimulus plan.
Do not accept arbitrary illumination as the final state; verify color, continuity and platform meaning.
Stop for wrong count/color/timing, heat, smoke, arcing, abnormal noise, power change or management loss.
Preserve PSU/BMC/SEL and host history instead of clearing logs.
Do not automatically re-trigger after an incomplete or ambiguous capture.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only PSU identity, power and health context before and after observation.
Prepare the N, timing and final-ON evidence worksheet.
Measure operator-supplied video while recording frame-rate/exposure limitations.
Report deviations without claiming direct observation or issuing the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve N, initial/final states, color, timing and tolerance.
Directly observe and record the complete physical sequence.
Distinguish intended final ON from alternate LED codes.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The manual-only statement is correct but cannot be executed until N and final illumination semantics are resolved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved read-only PSU/BMC queries to corroborate identity and state only. No remote command proves the flash count or final optical output, and no trigger command is inferred.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 remain unchanged. N, trigger, color, cadence, tolerance, final dwell and retry are absent.

modernized_recommendation.status: COUNTED TRANSITION VIDEO TO VERIFIED STEADY ON
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture timestamped/frame-rate-verified video from before the first flash through the final steady-on dwell, count complete cycles and correlate the final LED code with read-only PSU state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected CRPS PSU, bezel indicator and platform state machine.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU/chassis/firmware, LED-code document and capture metadata.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable PSU/chassis LED sequence documentation; no N, rate or color is invented.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes count and transition evidence auditable without replacing human acquisition.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers one defined sequence and final dwell, not repeated reliability or other LED codes.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: N, count rule, start state, blink parameters, final-ON semantics and capture specification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Dropped frames, aliasing, exposure and white balance can miscount flashes or misrepresent final color.

project_override_considerations: The project must define N and state/timing parameters. Record any approved alternative sequence and actual coverage; do not claim the master sequence from an incomplete recording or silently reuse a different PSU vendor's code.
expected_evidence: PSU identity plus approved N, initial state and final-ON definition
Color, cadence/tolerance, counting rule and final dwell
Operator worksheet and complete time-linked visual recording
Raw pre/post PSU/BMC power/health and preserved event delta
Capture limitations, discrepancies and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title defines the sequence shape and the body requests blinking behavior. Missing N and state semantics are project inputs, not a true contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sequence intent is clear. Undefined N and LED semantics gate execution but do not make the common case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep manual-only but expose N and final-code semantics as required inputs.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with physical counting and state correlation; strengthen complete-capture, color and no-retrigger constraints.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates human acquisition, optional media analysis, readiness and engineer verdict without inventing a sequence.

review_improvement: This review distinguishes a valid steady-ON ending from any illuminated warning or identification code and requires complete capture of N flashes, preventing both count and state false positives.
independent_technical_reasoning: The flash count and final optical state require physical viewing, so the case is MANUAL ONLY. Agent video analysis can support measurement but cannot replace operator acquisition. Undefined N and LED code are execution inputs rather than permission to guess or classify the library row permanently BLOCKED.

no_automatic_retry: If capture starts late, count/timing/color is wrong, final ON is ambiguous, or power/management changes, preserve media and telemetry and stop. Do not re-trigger, alter power, clear faults, reseat/unlatch the PSU, reboot or power-cycle automatically.
